welcome.speaker: Muhammad Jan
lines: Welcome to our village in Laghman. Walk with me to the Library; we will begin with a first hello.
Use the arrows or WASD to move. Stand next to a person and press E, Enter or Interact. The paths connect all four neighbourhoods.

actions.label: I will meet you at the Library

library.speaker: Muhammad Jan
lines: Our Library holds everything you learn. Let us practise choosing a meaning, arranging Pashto words, choosing your gender preference, and giving your name.

home.speaker: Muhammad Jan
lines: Welcome home. We can study descriptions together, or you can try the Day 1 challenge whenever you feel ready. You do not need to finish all four lessons first.

lake.speaker: Saleha
lines: Welcome to the lake. Let us learn the words for the world around us.

market.speaker: Edris
lines: Welcome to our market. There is plenty to learn among the stalls.

school.speaker: Ms Hameed
lines: Welcome to school. We will build on the words and forms you learn throughout the village.

reference.speaker: Library
lines: Your vocabulary, expressions and grammar reference are always available here. Voluntary Library practice awards no XP.

day1-ending.speaker: Muhammad Jan

1.name: A first hello
1.intro: Muhammad Jan will guide you to the Library for your first four activities. Then explore Home, Lake, Market and School in any order. Pass the Day 1 challenge to begin your first week.

2.name: Back to School
2.intro: We will use he and she with the first action verbs, placing the subject, object and verb in their licensed order.
2.objective: Normal: begin at School, visit four districts, then Muhammad Jan’s check-in. Early challenge: speak to Muhammad Jan at Home.

3.name: Speaking About Myself
3.intro: Tell us about yourself using I and the first-person forms you study today.
3.objective: Normal: begin at Lake, visit four districts, then Dinner shopping with Edris. Early challenge: speak to Edris at Market.

4.name: Talking to a Friend
4.intro: Practise speaking to one friend with informal you, and combine the licensed I and you clauses.
4.objective: Normal: begin at Home, visit four districts, then An informal conversation at Home. Early challenge: speak to Muhammad Jan at Home.

5.name: Speaking Respectfully
5.intro: Today we address elders and groups respectfully. The existing lesson teaches the approved peace greeting and response.
5.objective: Normal: begin at School, visit four districts, then Gathering at the Lake. Early challenge: speak to Saleha at Lake.

6.name: Together
6.intro: This is my sister Mina. We will practise speaking about ourselves as a group, then meet in the Hills.
6.objective: Normal: begin at Lake, visit four districts, then Together in the Hills. Early challenge: speak to Saleha at Hills.

7.name: Becoming a Resident
7.intro: Review what you have learned this week, including they and third-person plural, before Ms Hameed’s examination.
7.objective: Normal: begin at Market, visit four districts, then Week 1 examination. Early challenge: speak to Ms Hameed at School.
